кандидаты.name: Rule Persistence Across Compression
кандидаты.what: Techniques to keep instruction files (AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md) loaded and reloaded after context compaction, ensuring rules survive compression.

кандидаты.name: Policy Enforcement Middleware
кандидаты.what: Runtime layers that validate or filter LLM outputs against configurable policies to block prompt injection and enforce rules.

кандидаты.name: Prompt Structuring & Prioritization
кандидаты.what: Design patterns splitting prompts by role/scenario and using freshness/specificity rules to resolve conflicts.

кандидаты.name: State Machine & Workflow Persistence
кандидаты.what: Frameworks like LangGraph that manage agent state, checkpoints, and deterministic execution across steps.

кандидаты.name: Auditing & Observability
кандидаты.what: Systems that log, sign, and monitor LLM calls, providing traceability and detection of rule violations.

кандидаты.name: Deterministic Blueprint Framework
кандидаты.what: Approach separating workflow blueprint from model, enabling repeatable, rule‑driven execution.

кандидаты.name: Compression Hook Management
кандидаты.what: Hooks and bug fixes that run before or during context compression to preserve critical rule definitions.
